verdict.rationale: An in-browser toolbar for feedback, feature flags, and performance inspection is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions such a toolbar for live sites. Railway's dashboard canvas, metrics dashboards, preview environments, and the Railway Agent are separate features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
